text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: prefix-cache prefetch error rate spike on us-west-2. 5xx from runtime up ~4.8% over last 3m, overall token latency +120ms. Started 2523456780. Paging oncall maria.

maria: on it. can someone paste the quick dashboard link?

kevin: https://console.redwood/metrics/prefix-cache?range=15m — prefetch latency and error spikes line up with a large tenant burst (tenant-1213).

sam: seeing a second symptom: KV get failures for stale entries followed by fallback reads. Might be a prefetch hotloop.

maria: ok. first mitigation — disable prefetch for tiered-cache on us-west-2, enable short circuit-breaker for prefetch path (fail fast to origin). Doing a config flip now.

ops-bot: running: infra config set cache.prefetch.enabled=false --region us-west-2 --scope tiered-cache --requester maria (cmd id d3f9)

maria: ops-bot confirmed start. also bumping prefetch circuit-breaker to 10r/s and timeout 150ms.

ops-bot: running: infra config set cache.prefetch.circuit_breaker.rate=10 --cache tiered-cache --region us-west-2 --requester maria (cmd id d3fa)

kevin: patch applied. prefetch requests dropped ~85% in the last 30s. errors started to decay. latency trending down.

anne (cs): FYI CS: we're seeing inbound messages from 2 customers (alpha-co, beta-ml) about increased latency. I'm drafting a short message. Any ETA on when we can re-enable or whether we'll keep prefetch off?

maria: keeping off for now until we confirm no correctness regressions. Goal is 15m stabilise window. If stable, we'll re-enable with stricter circuit-breaker and rate limits.

sam: digging into logs — prefetch worker for tenant-1213 is retrying on 429s and compounding concurrency. There's also an edge case in our prefetch backoff that doesn't respect rate limiter after an origin 5xx. I'll push a quick guard to short-circuit retries for that tenant.

tess: can we do an immediate per-tenant carveout instead of global disable? That would be less customer-impacting.

maria: tried per-tenant carveout earlier but concurrency routing still had in-flight jobs. global off was fastest to stop the pressure. Next step: add tenant-level shielding for the noisy tenants once queue drains. sam, can you prepare shielding rule?

sam: yes. creating a tenant-shield rule:
```
shield add tenant-1213 --reason "prefetch storm" --region us-west-2 --max-prefetch=0 --until +30m
shield add tenant-1214 --reason "cohort burst" --region us-west-2 --max-prefetch=5 --until +30m
```

ops-bot: shield rules applied for tenant-1213 and tenant-1214 (cmd id d3fb).

kevin: telemetry shows prefetch queue depth down 92%, KV fallback reads are normalizing. 5xx at 30s window down from 4.8% to 0.7%.

anne (cs): sending interim note to affected accounts: "We applied temporary changes to prefetch to restore service stability in us-west-2. You may see slightly higher latency for cache-missed requests while we validate the fix. We're monitoring and will update in 30 minutes." Want to add anything?

maria: add that we disabled prefetch and are enabling tenant shielding; we expect normal behaviour to return in 15-30m. mention assigned oncall (maria) and SRE follow-up. :thumbsup:

anne (cs): message sent.

sam: I've pushed a small hotfix that ensures retries respect circuit-breaker state and backoff. Rolling to canary hosts in us-west-2 now.

ops-bot: deploy started: service prefetch-worker canary us-west-2 (deploy id dep-7783)

kevin: canary looks healthy after 2m. no additional error spikes.

maria: after canary, roll to remaining hosts with slow ramp 10%/30s. We'll keep prefetch off globally until canary fully rolled and we validate end-to-end.

tess: question for postmortem — do we have telemetry thresholds to auto-shield noisy tenants before global flips?

maria: yes, that's on the follow-up list. For now, main action items: 1) reconcile prefetch backoff bug (sam) 2) add auto-shield playbook + runbook (kevin + tess) 3) adjust circuit-breaker defaults and surface them in console (product) 4) customer comm follow-up (anne).

sam: I'm on 1). pushing PR, will link.

kevin: I'm drafting auto-shield RFC.

maria: ok folks — holding page but monitoring. if anything else pops, @incident-bot will re-alert. thanks for quick moves.

incident-bot: PAGE RESOLVED: status changed to MONITORING by maria at 2523457810.

maria: handing to oncall next shift (kevin) for postmortem and customer follow-ups. kev, you take it?

kevin: taking it. will coordinate postmortem and timeline for re-enabling prefetch with stricter limits.

anne (cs): will log affected customers and follow up with personalized notes after postmortem.

maria: done for now — closing thread in 30m unless metrics regress. :white_check_mark:
